messages:
anya: ok team quick sync on post-launch email flow for the Launchpad webinar attendees. thinking a 3-email micro-drip + weekly mini-digest for 3 weeks. Thoughts? :campfire:

matt: love it. segment attendees by watched >=50% vs registered but didn't attend. watched -> product tips + invite to feedback call. no-show -> on-demand recording + 1-week re-invite.

jess: subject ideas: 'Highlights from Launchpad' / 'You missed this — quick recap' — we should A/B test timeframe 24h vs 48h for first nudge.

oliver: agree on segments. also add a 'high-engagement' path for those who asked q's in chat or clicked resources (send advanced use cases).

anya: good. timeline: email0 immediate (thanks + recording), email1 at 48h (tips + CTA), email2 at 7d (case study + webinar invite). weekly mini-digest on Fridays — short, 3 bullets.

matt: for inbound routing: send high-engagement leads to SDR queue with tag 'webinar_watched_50plus', others to nurture list. can we add lead scoring rule? +5 pts for resource click.

jess: can marketing ops add UTM and hidden fields? I'll add template copy. cc @matt re: SDR handoff fields.

campaign-bot: campaign 'Launchpad-webinar-postlaunch-171450' scheduled. sends: email0 -> 1714513476, email1 -> 1714686276, email2 -> 1715118276. :robot_face:

oliver: quick copy tweak: make subject for email1 '3 quick wins from Launchpad' — more action-y.

anya: cool. Jess can you drop the templates and subject variants by EOD? Also need a 5-question micro survey for email2. keep it <30s.

jess: yes, I'll drop templates in #marketing-ops and upload to campaign manager. sample snippet for scheduling via HubSpot API:

curl -X POST 'https://api.hubspot.com/marketing/v3/campaigns' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{TOKEN}}' \
  -d '{"name":"Launchpad postlaunch","sendDate":"2024-04-01T15:00:00Z"}'

will attach UTM strings.

anya: perfect. one last ask: can we rotate subject lines across cohorts to avoid deliverability fatigue? maybe 3 variants.

matt: yes. ops, can you add suppression for users who unsub in email0. also set send window 10am-2pm local.

jess: noted. adding 3 subject variants and scheduling A/B. will also create segment for 'clicked recording' for faster follow-up.

oliver: propose a small experiment: run a tiny cohort (5%) with quantized CTAs (single CTA vs multi-CTA) to measure click-to-conversion.

anya: love it — run experiment on first 48h send. thanks everyone! I'll compile next steps and owners.
